$comment: NOT a valid opencode.json hooks config. opencode has no `hooks` key (see https://opencode.ai/docs/config/, retrieved 2026-09-06); hooks are TypeScript plugins (see https://opencode.ai/docs/plugins/, retrieved 2026-09-06) with events session.created/deleted/idle, tool.execute.before/after, etc. There is no SkillInvocationEnd or AgentSessionEnd event and no ${skill_name}/${tokens_in} template vars. The prior content of this file was fictional and has been replaced. For the doc-backed run-boundary plugin, see observe.plugin.js in this directory (session.idle -> log_run.py, tokens/duration null when unknown). Convention-based `log_run.py --record` remains the default; hook-based emission is aspirational until per-skill token attribution exists.
